svg.title: The controlled-disclosure row: five weeks of argument, and a claim built so it cannot lose
svg.desc: A two-panel diagram. The upper panel is a chronology of the row between Luis Elizondo and the anonymous researcher UAP Gerb, running from 28 June 2026, when the journalist Ross Coulthart said on a NewsNation question-and-answer that Elizondo had held a counterintelligence role inside the legacy crash-retrieval programme, through Elizondo's denial the next day, Coulthart's early-July clarification that he had been misreported, the late-July Reality Check interview with UAP Gerb in which an appointment to the National Security Council was alleged, Elizondo's video reply of 29 July recorded at a highway rest stop, the position as it stands on 6 August, and the publication of Elizondo's book Reckoning on 27 August. Each entry is marked as either an unverified assertion, a matter of record, unresolved, or a test still to come. A running count below records six broadcasts, videos and replies, and no named sources, dated records or documents produced by either side. The lower panel shows five mutually exclusive things that could happen next — Elizondo denies the allegation, takes a White House job, takes no job, real disclosure follows, or no disclosure follows — with an arrow curving from every one of them into a single stamped verdict reading THEORY CONFIRMED, NO EXIT.
svg.text: CASE FILE // THE CONTROLLED-DISCLOSURE ROW — SUMMER 2026
Who said what, and when — and why none of it can currently be tested.

g.text: Says Elizondo held a counterintelligence role inside the legacy retrieval effort.
Denies being part of a legacy programme; says "neither confirm nor deny" is routine.
Coulthart says he was misreported — and that Elizondo never directly denied it.
AATIP recast as cover; an NSC role alleged. Roswell to the Podesta emails, no papers.
"1,000% not accurate." Confirms one fact: he is moving to Washington.
No appointment announced, nothing produced. Five weeks of people answering each other.
A fixed date — and the first thing here that can be checked rather than argued.
Broadcasts, videos and replies: six. Named sources, dated records or documents produced by either side: none.
02 — EVERY OUTCOME IS ALREADY ACCOUNTED FOR
He denies it, flatly, on camera
Which is exactly what a managed asset would do.
He takes the White House job
The placement worked, precisely as described.
He takes no job at all
The plan was adjusted once it had been exposed.
The minimum they were ever going to concede.
The containment held. It generally does.

svg.text: A claim that survives every possible observation isn’t strong. It is untestable.
That is a statement about how the argument has been built, not about whether the underlying story is true.
It may well be true. But it cannot currently be checked, and an argument that cannot be checked is not yet knowledge.
UAP TIMES — DIAGRAM OF AN ARGUMENT, NOT OF AN EVENT
